race.description: Ladbrokes Big Bets Copy Now Hcp
race.comment: HELL (7) shouldered a big weight and did well to be beaten under a length when resuming over this distance at Eagle Farm last start. Steps up to open company but gets plenty of weight relief. Loves Doomben so this looks a perfect second-up scenario. TALTARNI FIELDS (6) drove hard but just failed to nab EPIC PROPORTIONS over 1110m here a fortnight ago. Track specialist who just needs a couple of breaks from the wide draw to be right in the finish again. PEREILLE (3) brings the black-type form to the race, a barnstorming second in the Ramornie at Grafton a month ago. Class runner who gets every chance from a nice gate. HATCHET (4) caught the eye late behind a few of today's key rivals here recently. Nine-time winner over 1200m at this track which speaks for itself. EPIC PROPORTIONS (1) won fair and square over 1110m here last time. Open to further improvement out to this trip at just the third run of the campaign.
